in_hebrew.name: Gagnon
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gagnon הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Gagnon is of French origin and is derived from the Old French word 'gagnant', which means 'winner' or 'victorious'. This name has no direct biblical or spiritual connection, but its meaning embodies the spirit of perseverance and triumph.
